hints: Watch the motor's speed once it gets going. Does it jump up and down, or stay level?

The power switches on and off 1000 times a second. Inertia means the motor's heavy spinning parts want to keep spinning. They can't follow pulses that fast, so they smooth them out. Think of a playground roundabout getting lots of quick shoves: it spins steadily.
Set the duty cycle to 20%. Does the motor jerk, or settle at a lower, steady speed?
